column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3647): each of the two cases puts the real handler chain and a real TenantStore on the application login behind a client abort during a drop, on SQL Server only (the session context it checks exists only there), and gets its database from testutil.TestDB, which skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is unset. test-go/commands runs cmd/cleat-worker with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so both skip there: 2 skips, measured 2026-11-07 by running the test with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set and reading the skip names. Both cases run, and pass, with CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set.
